$comment: SYNTHETIC fixture mirroring a BOB-governed AquaAgent repo. Every record is_synthetic. Names and ids are illustrative; no real AquaAgent data.

requirements.text: Source register for every question source
requirements.check: sources.json lists each named source with access, processing and knowledge_use states
two near-identical questions collapse to one row with both source ids

requirements.text: Question bank with provenance, one row per de-duplicated question
requirements.check: row count equals the de-duplicated set; five sampled rows trace to their source

requirements.text: Sequence pulls read from the bank
requirements.check: a run pulls its question sequence from the bank, not a prompt literal

requirements.text: Export of the bank with provenance
requirements.check: export bundle contains every row and its source ids

decisions.text: Question bank lives in Supabase with provenance columns

assumptions.text: All question sources are reachable from authorised Drive and Evernote exports
assumptions.falsified_by: source register shows a source as missing or inaccessible
